Agent Name: Research_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The first mistake was the assumption in step 1 that Fubo’s IPO year needed to be searched first without yet confirming the correct public-listing year and source details. More importantly, the conversation then treated “ahead of its NYSE debut” from Reuters as definitive proof of the IPO year without explicitly establishing the exact date/year from a reliable source. The real failure that would lead to a wrong final answer is that the agent never successfully gathered and verified the joining years of the management team members, so it could not correctly identify which executives joined in 2020.
